claims.content: Customer
The Customer accesses the 'My Account Edit Page' (e.g., the 'Change Membership Account Information' page) to update their stored account data.
The Customer's updated membership account information (First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, Password) is saved to the system and persisted.
The Customer's selected email notification preferences ('notify me when I am outbid', 'notify me when I win an auction', 'notify me when my winnings are shipped') are saved.
After the changes are saved, the Customer is returned to the My Account page.
The Customer has an existing account with registration/identity data (First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone) and a current password stored in the system.
The Customer is authenticated (logged in) with an active session.
The Customer wants to update their membership account information (such as First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, and Password) and manage email notification preferences.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to update their membership account information (such as First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, and Password) and manage email notification preferences.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer opens the Change Membership Account Information page, enters updated membership account information (First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, Password) and email notification preferences, and saves the changes.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer has accessed the My Account Edit Page to update their stored account data.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has saved the updated membership account information and email notification preferences.
in_scope_actions: Accessing the Change Membership Account Information page
Entering updated membership account information (First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, Password)
excluded_adjacent_actions: Managing site-wide global/default auction settings (Auction Administration 'Manage Global Settings')
Post-save navigation or downstream administrative processing
variant_dimensions: Selectable account settings categories: membership information, billing/shipping addresses, payment methods, email notification preferences

claims.content: If the Customer does not complete the current-password authorization step before making changes, the system prevents modification of the membership account information.

If the Customer attempts to save changes while the password fields contain mismatched values, the system's UI structure implies a validation failure path, though explicit rejection behavior is not depicted in the available evidence.
If the Customer enters a password outside the 8-to-12-character range, the system triggers a validation error and prevents the save.
If the Customer enters an E-mail Address that already exists in the customer table, the system treats it as an error condition requiring correction.
If the Customer enters a Member ID ('Handle') that already exists in the customer table, the system enters an error state.
If the Customer's paytype is PayPal or Amazon, the 'Please notify me when I win an auction' checkbox is grayed out, preventing the Customer from de-selecting that email notification preference.

missing_aspects: Explicit continuation/retry behavior after save-rejection exceptions is not documented in the evidence.
Explicit confirmation that the system actively rejects the save action for password mismatches on the relevant page (distinct from the implied logic on the Admin page).

claims.content: The Customer views the 'My Current Information' section on the Change Membership Account Information page, which displays their existing First Name, Last Name, Member ID ('Handle'), E-mail Address, and Phone and requires entry of the Current Password to authorize changes.
The Customer enters their Current Password in the 'My Current Information' section to authorize the account changes.

The Customer enters updated information into the 'My New Information' section fields: First Name, Last Name, Member ID ('Handle'), E-mail Address (entered twice for verification), Phone, and Password (entered twice for verification).

The Customer manages email notification preferences by selecting the desired checkboxes: 'notify me via email when I am outbid', 'notify me when I win an auction', and 'notify me when my winnings are shipped'.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button.
The system saves the updated membership account information (First Name, Last Name, Member ID, E-mail Address, Phone, Password) and the selected email notification preferences.
The system returns the Customer to the My Account page.
